title: Number classifier
description: Create a program that determines whether a number is positive, negative or zero using if-else.
hints: Use if (numero > 0), else if (numero < 0), else for zero
You can change the value of the variable to test
solutionExplanation: We use if for positive (>0), else if for negative (<0), and else for the remaining case (zero). Only one branch is executed.

title: Body mass index calculator
description: Calculate the BMI from weight and height, and show the category: underweight (<18.5), normal (18.5-24.9), overweight (25-29.9), obesity (>=30).
hints: The order of the if matters: check the lowest ranges first
solutionExplanation: BMI = weight / height². The chained if-else conditions classify the result into ranges. Since they are mutually exclusive, order matters.
expectedOutput:
Weight: 72.0 kg, Height: 1.75 m
BMI: 23.5 - Normal

title: Password validator with multiple rules
description: Validate a password against 4 rules: length >= 8, contains uppercase, contains number, contains special character (@#$). Show feedback according to how many rules it meets.
solutionExplanation: We evaluate each rule separately with if and accumulate them in a counter. We classify with else-if according to the number of rules met. The for-each loop iterates over each character.
